source_review.notes: Checked all nine references for identity, authority, date, and claim scope. Google SRE supports staged evaluation and rollback as controlled release practice. Current AWS Builders' Library material supports alarm-driven immutable rollback deployment, upgrade-downgrade testing, mixed-version compatibility, two-stage format changes, and backfill; these are labeled documented AWS practices. Current Kubernetes documentation supports prior Deployment revision restoration while explicitly limiting a revision to Pod-template changes. Humble/Farley, Nygard, Kleppmann, and NIST support durable recovery, compatibility, distributed-state, and contingency vocabulary. Checked 2026-09-06.
